title: Состав выпуска: aicore release bundle — compat-manifest/v1, пакет схем, аттестация, SHA256SUMS; swissknifeman release bundle
summary: aicore release bundle --root --tag --out пишет compat.json (compat-manifest/v1 из unit.json модулей и мостов), детерминированный schemas-<tag>.tar.gz с index.json, release-attestation.json (aicore.release.attestation.build по HEAD, tag — метка) и SHA256SUMS; swissknifeman release bundle маршрутизирует туда; release без bundle остаётся у skiller.
why: D83, D26, E41; knowledge/hub-p12#release. Риски: (1) недетерминированный архив (mtime, порядок, uid) — два запуска сравниваются побайтно; (2) attestation.build требует тег — tag в bundle только метка, аттестация по ref HEAD; (3) запись вне --out запрещена.

guidance:
Исполнитель: implementation/medium.

Порядок: compat-manifest/v1 → bundle.py (compat, архив схем, аттестация, SHA256SUMS) → CLI aicore release bundle → тест на фикстуре хаба (состав, детерминизм, sha256sum -c, схема) → umbrella release bundle (алиас release остаётся у skiller) → CHANGELOG → V1–V3.

validation.cmd: H=$(mktemp -d) && for n in a b; do HOME=$H SKM_HOME=$H/skm bin/swissknifeman release bundle --root . --tag v0.0.0-p12 --out $H/$n || exit 1; done && (cd $H/a && sha256sum -c --quiet SHA256SUMS) && test -f $H/a/compat.json && cmp $H/a/schemas-v0.0.0-p12.tar.gz $H/b/schemas-v0.0.0-p12.tar.gz && cmp $H/a/compat.json $H/b/compat.json
python3 scripts/test-umbrella.py && python3 scripts/golden.py check && python3 scripts/public-hygiene.py

result.notes:
Added aicore.release.bundle and the CLI group `aicore release bundle --root --tag --out`. It writes compat.json (compat-manifest/v1 from unit.json of packages/* and bridges/*), a deterministic schemas-<tag>.tar.gz with index.json {id,version,path,sha256}, release-attestation.json (attestation.build at ref HEAD; the tag is only a label) and SHA256SUMS. A non-empty --out gives OUT_NOT_EMPTY (exit 2); a bad tag gives TAG_INVALID (exit 2). Everything is built in memory and written to --out only after all steps succeed. New contract packages/aicore/schemas/compat-manifest/v1 (schema, 2 valid and 4 invalid examples), listed in aicore unit.json provides.contracts. The `release` alias in configs/umbrella.json now routes `bundle` to aicore; other release words stay with skiller. Added tests test_bundle.py (10 tests) and TestReleaseBundleRoute (2 tests). Golden help cases recaptured for the changed alias description. Both CHANGELOGs updated. Narrow tests run and green: aicore tests.release.test_bundle, tests.test_contracts, tests.test_architecture; scripts/test-umbrella.py (57); golden.py check; public-hygiene; ecosystem-units.py check; aicore schema compat --base origin/ecosystem-split (0 errors). Manual V2-equivalent run of the real hub: two runs are byte-identical for tar.gz and compat.json, and sha256sum -c passes.
Changed: CHANGELOG.md, configs/umbrella.json, packages/aicore/CHANGELOG.md, packages/aicore/lib/aicore/cli.py, packages/aicore/lib/aicore/release/bundle.py, packages/aicore/schemas/README.md, packages/aicore/schemas/compat-manifest/v1/compat-manifest.schema.json, packages/aicore/schemas/compat-manifest/v1/examples/invalid/bad-stability.json, packages/aicore/schemas/compat-manifest/v1/examples/invalid/bad-version.json, packages/aicore/schemas/compat-manifest/v1/examples/invalid/extra-field.json, packages/aicore/schemas/compat-manifest/v1/examples/invalid/missing-bridges.json, packages/aicore/schemas/compat-manifest/v1/examples/valid/empty.json, packages/aicore/schemas/compat-manifest/v1/examples/valid/hub.json, packages/aicore/tests/release/test_bundle.py, packages/aicore/unit.json, scripts/test-umbrella.py, tests/golden/cases.json, tests/golden/cli/swissknifeman-help.txt, tests/golden/cli/swissknifeman-unknown-subcommand.txt, tests/golden/generation.json
